source_title: European football: Kane misses penalty as Dortmund share spoils in Der Klassiker
source_excerpt:
Bayern Munich held to 2-2 draw after Silva equaliser
Bayern Munich held to 2-2 draw after Silva equaliser
Barcelona on top of La Liga after thrashng Alaves
Barcelona on top of La Liga after thrashng Alaves
The Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane missed a penalty and hit the post for ⁠ Bayern Munich as Borussia Dortmund snatched a last-gasp equaliser through Fabio Silva for a 2-2 draw ⁠in Der Klassiker on ⁠Saturday ​that kept the teams level on points at the top.
Kane, who collected his prize in a ceremony ⁠in London on Monday, was an unused substitute in the 6-1 German Cup second-round demolition of Magdeburg on Wednesday ⁠but returned to the starting lineup on Saturday, missing from the spot with Bayern 1-0 up. He also hit ​the post, one of four ‌times Bayern struck ‌the woodwork. Silva snatched the equaliser in the 89th minute to leave both ‌teams on 18 points, with Bayern top on goal difference.
In a rollercoaster first half Bayern hit the post through Michael Olise and Ismael Saibari missed a golden chance before the visitors had a goal ruled out by VAR.
Bayern, ‌also hit by injuries to Serge Gnabry and Olise, struck in the 38th minute thanks to Konrad Laimer’s goal on ​the rebound, after his first effort was blocked by Dortmund’s Gregor Kobel.
With the Bayern head coach, Vincent Kompany, recovering after his collapse last week, Bayern’s full-back Laimer was more threatening than Kane, who sent his 56th ⁠minute spot-kick against the crossbar. Dortmund scored through Serhou Guirassy on ​the hour but parity lasted only ​six minutes as Dayot Upamecano tapped in from a Kane ​assist from close ‌range.
Kane’s low shot ​bounced off ​the post before Silva scored the equaliser. Bayern’s Lennart Karl still had time to see his shot in stoppage time bounce off the crossbar and cap a frustrating day for the champions.
Elsewhere in the Bundesliga , last season’s Europa League finalists Freiburg beat Augsburg 2-1 thanks to Cyriaque Irié’s 85th-minute goal to stay third. RB Leipzig are close behind in fourth after beating Schalke 2-0. The league top scorer, Niclas Füllkrug, added his ninth goal as Werder Bremen beat Hoffenheim 2-0 to move up to fifth. Bayer Leverkusen ’s strong early form hit another setback in a 4-2 loss at home to Stuttgart for back-to-back defeats. Borussia Mönchengladbach and Paderborn drew 0-0.
In Spain, Barcelona enjoyed an emphatic 6-1 home win over Alaves , with Raphinha, Fermín López, Lamine ⁠Yamal and Anthony Gordon all on the scoresheet, as the hosts responded after losses to Real Madrid and Paris St Germain. Barcelona ⁠top La Liga on 30 ⁠points, two ​ahead of Atlético Madrid , who beat Levante 2-0 earlier on Saturday, with Real Madrid six points off the pace before ⁠visiting Racing Santander on Sunday.
The opening exchanges at Camp Nou were punctuated by frustrated shouts from the home manager, Hansi Flick, in response to ⁠Barcelona’s defending, but Alaves soon found it impossible to live with their fluid attacking play.
“It was a hard week for us, there was no better place than Camp Nou in front of our fans [to bounce back],” López said. “They make the difference, Lamine and Raphinha, with them we will achieve big things.”
There was a minute’s silence at the start of each of the day’s matches in memory of the 69 victims of the train crash in the province of Toledo .
In Italy, Milan ’s Diego Moreira claimed one goal and two assists as his side took three precious points with a 3-1 victory over Inter in their Serie A derby on Saturday, while Roma enjoyed a 5-2 victory at ⁠ Udinese .
In a week when ⁠the clubs ​shared more details of San Siro’s replacement , Milan’s fast start earned the win that lifts them into fourth ⁠place, four points behind leaders Lazio and Inter who have 25. The result means Lazio can move three points clear of Inter when they host Cagliari on Sunday. Roma ⁠are third on 24 points.
Milan made the perfect start as Christian Pulisic headed their opener after four minutes ​before Adrien Rabiot added a second six minutes ‌later. Inter pulled a goal ‌back through Alessandro Bastoni in the 22nd and the momentum was with them.
The next goal was always ‌going to be crucial and it went to Milan as Moreira scored with a superb free-kick just before half-time to help his side to a fourth straight win over Inter.
Roma were 4-0 up in 37 minutes at Udinese as they overwhelmed the hosts, who are second-bottom on five points. Bryan Cristante headed the first goal after 10 minutes, before Matías Soulé and Donyell Malen struck the woodwork. Rodrigo Mora ‌netted the second in the 31st minute after being set up by Cristante, and two minutes later Malen scored his eighth Serie A goal of the season.
Evan Ndicka ​headed the fourth from a corner before half-time after which Udinese mounted something of a comeback. Nicolò Zaniolo and Matteo Palma scored for the hosts but Daniele Ghilardi added a fifth, his first Serie A goal, for Roma.
Bologna climbed to ninth with ​a third successive league win thanks ​to a 2-1 victory over Monza , their first home success since April. Tommaso Pobega and ​Federico Bernardeschi netted for ‌Bologna, after the ​visitors scored an early ​penalty through Gustavo Varela, the top Serie A scorer with nine goals in as many games. He had been substituted by the time Monza were awarded a second penalty in the final 10 minutes and this time Patrick Cutrone missed from the spot as they were denied a point.

## यूरोपीय फुटबॉल: 'डेर क्लासिकर' में बायरन म्यूनिख और बोरूसिया डार्टमुंड का मुकाबला बराबरी पर छूटा

शनिवार को खेले गए 'डेर क्लासिकर' (Der Klassiker) मुकाबले में बायरन म्यूनिख और बोरूसिया डार्टमुंड का मैच 2-2 की बराबरी पर समाप्त हुआ। इस मुकाबले में हाल ही में पुरस्कार जीतने वाले हैरी केन (Harry Kane) ने पेनल्टी मिस की और गेंद पोस्ट पर भी लगी। मैच के अंतिम क्षणों में फाबियो सिल्वा (Fabio Silva) ने गोल कर बोरूसिया डार्टमुंड को बराबरी दिलाई। इस परिणाम के बाद दोनों टीमें अंक तालिका में शीर्ष पर बनी हुई हैं।

## मैच के मुख्य आकर्षण
* **पेनल्टी से चूके केन:** बायरन म्यूनिख के लिए खेलते हुए हैरी केन पेनल्टी को गोल में बदलने में असफल रहे।
* **गोलरहित प्रयास:** मैच के दौरान बायरन म्यूनिख के खिलाड़ियों के कई शॉट गोल पोस्ट से टकराए।
* **अंतिम समय में बराबरी:** खेल के 89वें मिनट में सिल्वा ने गोल करके डार्टमुंड को हार से बचाया।

मैच के दौरान कोनराड लाइमर और दायोट उपामेकानो ने बायरन के लिए गोल किए, जबकि डार्टमुंड की ओर से सेरहू गुइरासी ने भी गोल दागा। इस मुकाबले के बाद दोनों टीमों के 18-18 अंक हैं, हालांकि बायरन म्यूनिख बेहतर गोल अंतर के कारण शीर्ष पर है।

## अन्य लीग मुकाबले
* **स्पेन (ला लीगा):** बार्सिलोना ने अлавеस के खिलाफ शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए 6-1 से जीत दर्ज की और ला लीगा में शीर्ष स्थान हासिल किया।
* **इटली (सेरी ए):** मिलान ने इंटर मिलान को 3-1 से हराया, जिसमें डिएगो मोरेरा ने एक गोल किया और दो में सहायता की। रोमा ने उदिनेस को 5-2 से हराया।

## सत्यापन और जानकारी
दर्शकों और पाठकों से अनुरोध है कि वे अधिकृत खेल वेबसाइटों, क्लबों के आधिकारिक सोशल मीडिया हैंडल और खेल समाचार पोर्टलों के माध्यम से स्कोर, खिलाड़ियों के आंकड़ों और आगामी मैचों की आधिकारिक घोषणाओं का सत्यापन करें।

en_body:
## Der Klassiker Ends in Stalemate

Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund remain level on points at the top of the Bundesliga following a 2-2 draw in *Der Klassiker*. Fabio Silva secured a dramatic late equaliser for Dortmund in the 89th minute, denying Bayern victory in a match marked by multiple missed opportunities.

Recently crowned Ballon d’Or winner Harry Kane returned to Bayern's starting lineup and experienced a frustrating outing. The forward missed a 56th-minute penalty by hitting the crossbar and later struck the post, contributing to a total of four occasions where Bayern hit the woodwork during the encounter.

* Konrad Laimer opened the scoring for Bayern in the 38th minute on the rebound.
* Serhou Guirassy equalised for Dortmund on the hour mark.
* Dayot Upamecano quickly restored Bayern's lead following an assist from Kane before Silva's late response.

Elsewhere in the Bundesliga, Freiburg defeated Augsburg 2-1, RB Leipzig overcame Schalke 2-0, and Werder Bremen edged Hoffenheim 2-0.

## Barcelona Responds in La Liga

In Spain, Barcelona returned to winning ways with a 6-1 thrashing of Alaves at Camp Nou. Following recent defeats, Hansi Flick's side produced a fluid attacking display featuring goals from Raphinha, Fermín López, Lamine Yamal, and Anthony Gordon. The victory leaves Barcelona at the summit of La Liga on 30 points, two ahead of Atlético Madrid.

## Milan Secures Derby Victory in Serie A

In Italy, Milan triumphed 3-1 over Inter in their Serie A derby, driven by a standout performance from Diego Moreira, who contributed one goal and two assists. The result lifts Milan into fourth place in the standings.

* Christian Pulisic opened the scoring with a fourth-minute header.
* Adrien Rabiot doubled Milan's lead shortly after.
* Alessandro Bastoni pulled one back for Inter before Moreira secured the win with a free-kick.

In other Italian fixtures, Roma claimed a 5-2 victory away at Udinese, while Bologna edged Monza 2-1.
